item.title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending

turns.text: Make a silent 8-second vertical coffee clip: a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup for 5 seconds, then a plain black end card for the last 3 seconds. Center this exact URL in white: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — keep the capitals and punctuation exactly as typed, all on one line. Nothing else written anywhere.

item.tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

answer_sheet.Exact URL: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — no trailing punctuation, spaces or quotation marks.
answer_sheet.End card styling: Plain black background, centered white URL on one line; font is your call.
answer_sheet.Scene and timing: Coffee pouring into a ceramic cup for the first 5 seconds, followed by the end card for the final 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Cup and setting details: Your call, provided the cup is ceramic and the pouring is shown close up.

must_haves: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt:
Create an exactly 8-second silent vertical video with precisely two shots and one hard cut at 5.000 seconds. From 0.000 to 5.000 seconds: photorealistic cinematic close-up of hot dark coffee continuously pouring in a thin stream from an unmarked carafe into a simple unmarked ceramic cup. Warm natural morning light, delicate steam, shallow depth of field, cozy neutral tabletop background, locked-off camera. Frame the cup and coffee stream closely. No people needed. No labels, logos, watermarks, writing, captions or text anywhere in this opening shot. At exactly 5.000 seconds hard cut directly to a completely plain solid black end card; no transition, no fade. Hold this static end card unchanged from 5.000 through 8.000 seconds. End card contains ONLY this exact single-line text in plain white sans-serif type, horizontally and vertically centered: https://example.com/Go?ref=June
Render that URL literally, preserving its exact capitalization and all punctuation: capital G in Go and capital J in June, colon, two slashes, dot, slash, question mark, equals sign. No quotation marks, no trailing punctuation, no added spaces, no line breaks within the URL. Use a small enough font to fit the entire URL on ONE line within the vertical frame with comfortable side margins. Nothing else may be written anywhere in the video. No other end-card graphics. No audio, no music, no speech, no sound effects. Exact timing: coffee pouring 5 seconds, black URL end card 3 seconds, total 8 seconds.
